messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: High rate of smart-routing fallback loops detected. Multiple customers in eu-west-1 are being routed to us-east-1 repeatedly -> large request latencies and increased error rates. Automations flagged a model compatibility mismatch around quantized vs fp16 variants. Pager opened: PD-9341.

sam: ack. I'm oncall for infra. Observed latency spikes ~2000ms -> 12s for affected requests. Which customers hit first?

jordan: @sam customer-success sees three paying customers reporting UI hangs. One enterprise (org-id: org_87) reported repeated 504s. They started at ~12:35 UTC.

maria: looking at router logs now. Initial suspicion: smart-routing fallback policy is bouncing from eu-west-1 -> us-east-1 because eu variant marked incompatible for tool_calling/context_len. But the eu variant is actually compatible; compatibility matrix appears stale for some quantized builds.

kevin: can you paste the routing decision snippet? Also any errors from model-selector?

maria: logs: 
```
[2026-06-12T12:34:56Z] route_decision: region=eu-west-1 preferred_variant=model-x-q4_0, compat_check=false, reason="tool_calling=false"
[2026-06-12T12:34:56Z] fallback: to us-east-1 variant=model-x-fp16, latency_ms=3400
[2026-06-12T12:34:57Z] route_decision: incoming from eu-west-1 hits us-east-1, miss cache, re-route back -> loop_count=3
```
maria: also compatibility table shows model-x-q4_0 flagged as 'tool_calling: false' when the build actually supports tool_calling. Seems like metadata for quantized variant didn't get updated after the build pipeline change.

ops-oncall: paging customers and escalating. Is there a quick mitigation? We can disable cross-region fallback as a temporary stopgap.

sam: let's do that. Step 1: turn off region fallback for smart-routing policy for affected routes. Step 2: pin eu-west-1 to a known-good variant (model-x-fp16) until matrix fixed. Step 3: notify CS and customers. I'll implement step 1 now.

devops-bot: running command: `rbctl routing update --policy smart-routing --no-region-fallback --scope=eu-west-1`

devops-bot: success: policy updated (txn 0x9a3f).

sam: pinning eu-west-1 default variant to model-x-fp16: `rbctl model pin --region eu-west-1 --model model-x --variant model-x-fp16 --ttl 30m`

devops-bot: pin applied.

maria: confirming traffic: eu-west-1 traffic now stays in-region on fp16. Fallback loops stop immediately. Latency dropping back to baseline (~120-220ms).

jordan: notified impacted customers. Sent interim status: "We've applied an inbound routing pin to eu-west-1 and disabled cross-region fallback while we investigate. Expect latency to recover within 10-20 minutes."

kevin: good. What's the root cause hypothesis?

maria: preliminary: compatibility metadata sync failed between the model build pipeline and the serving metadata store for q4_0 quantized variants. Build added tool_calling capability (and adjusted max_context to 8192), but the metadata table still lists tool_calling=false and max_context=4096. Smart-router uses that metadata to decide compatibility -> false positives for incompatibility -> triggers cross-region fallback.

sam: timeline notes: first alert 12:34:56Z, mitigation applied by 12:37:12Z. Customer recovery confirmed 12:50:30Z. Estimated outage window ~16 minutes for affected requests.

maria: I pulled the metadata entry: 
```
# metadata record for model-x-q4_0
model: model-x-q4_0
tool_calling: "false"  # actual build supports it
max_context: "4096"
build_sha: "a1b2c3"
```
maria: actual build artifact reports: 
```
artifact: model-x-q4_0
tool_calling: true
max_context: 8192
build_sha: "a1b2c3"
```
maria: mismatch is clear. Sync job between build pipeline and metadata-store failed on 2026-06-12 due to transient S3 permission error.

kevin: ok. Immediate follow-ups: 1) re-run metadata sync for affected builds, 2) add a guard in smart-router to double-check artifact capability via a lightweight probe rather than solely trusting metadata, 3) alerting: add a monitor for mismatches between artifact manifests and metadata store.

devops-bot: submitted ticket INFRA-2112 to re-run sync and add monitoring.

ops-oncall: CS update: enterprise org_87 acknowledged the interim fix and will re-test; asked for RCA and ETA for full fix.

jordan: customer asked how many requests impacted: we estimate ~0.2% of total platform traffic during the window, concentrated on tenants using tool-calling. One enterprise had visible UI failures; others saw slow responses.

sam: any risk in re-enabling region fallback now? If we re-enable before matrix fixed we'll hit the same loop. So hold off. We'll keep fallback disabled for 24h or until metadata corrections verified.

maria: I'm re-running sync now: `ci-sync --target=metadata-store --filter=model-x-q4_0 --force`

maria: sync finished. Metadata now matches artifact: tool_calling=true, max_context=8192.

maria: test: compatibility check for model-x-q4_0 returns true for tool_calling and context 8k.

kevin: recommend controlled restore: 1) re-enable region fallback but add a conservative cooldown (no immediate cross-region mirroring unless variant compat confirmed by probe). 2) remove pin after circuit has been stable for 1 hour.

sam: agreed. I'll schedule a canary: enable fallback with probe gating for 5% of new flows in eu-west-1 for 30m. If no regressions, ramp.

devops-bot: scheduled: `rbctl routing update --policy smart-routing --region-gating=eu-west-1 --canary=5% --probe=artifact-capability-check` at 13:45Z.

devops-bot: canary started at 13:45:00Z. No errors observed in initial 20m. Latency, error rates normal.

jordan: CS confirmed org_87 saw successful retry and load restored. They're happy with the update and requested the RCA doc.

maria: root cause: metadata sync job failed due to temporary S3 role expiry during automated pipeline rotation. Follow-ups: extend retry/backoff on sync job, add post-deploy verification, and add manifest->metadata consistency alert.

kevin: owners: infra to fix sync job and add alert (owner: sam), serving/mdb to add probe guard in router (owner: maria), product to coordinate customer comms (owner: jordan).

sam: will open follow-up tickets and assign. Postmortem stub created: PM-4054.

ops-oncall: closing the on-call loop. Incident marked mitigated at 13:01:30Z (service metrics stable). Full resolution after canary ramp at 14:15Z.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated. Severity: Sev2. Brief impact: region routing fallback loops caused temporary latency spikes and request failures for a small subset of customers using tool-calling with quantized variants. Action items assigned.

kevin: good job team. We'll prepare RCA and include timeline, root cause, and the three engineering actions.

jordan: I'll draft the customer-facing RCA and loop back with exact impacted org list.

maria: I'll run a quick audit to find any other variants with metadata drift and send results by EOD.
